name: Kipping Muscle-Up
steps: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip and start a controlled swing between arched and hollow positions.
As you swing into the hollow position, drive your hips toward the bar and pull the bar toward your waist.
Bring your chest over the bar and turn both elbows above it together.
Press down into straight-arm support with the bar at your hips, then lower through the transition to a hang.
tips: Keep your core tight through the hollow-to-arch swing rather than letting your legs flail loosely.
Pull the bar toward your hips rather than your chin so you create space for a smooth transition over the bar.
